summary: Stop iOS Fabric packaging from waiting on unrelated Xcode jobs and timestamp release-delivery worker phases.

replay.detail: Internal build tooling only; no replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No persistent state or database schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination rule changes; callers still own build admission.

compatibility.detail: No app, signing, client or wire contract changes. Packaging uses module-local libraries and headers without querying unrelated host processes; worker logs add UTC phase-start timestamps.

downtime.detail: This source change neither deploys a scheduler nor installs or restarts an app.

manual.detail: Deployment configuration owners must repin the reviewed release_delivery.py source to adopt phase timestamps. Manual builders must not package concurrently into the same output directory.

recovery.detail: Existing failure backoff, artifact verification and installed-version protections are unchanged. No foreign Xcode process needs to be stopped for packaging.
